context: 2026-11-18 evidence (PR #4351, f9dd3fc25e): root causes — (1) test_cancellation_kills_trapping_child_and_grandchild: an interrupt landing inside Popen.wait leaks the Popen wait lock, so no later Popen.wait can reap the direct child, which stays a zombie; fixed by reaping it with a background os.waitpid when the bounded wait times out (tests/uat/timeouts.py). (2) test_the_real_stop_process_is_group_killed_with_its_output_kept_and_no_leaked_worker: the test read the worker pid file before the shell had written the pid; it now waits for a complete line. Both tests together passed 200 of 200 sequential repetitions on this host through make heavy-run (idle-host admission, no deliberate load), 2026-11-18. No skip, xfail, rerun marker or relaxed assertion.
description:
## Problem
Two tests failed once each on unrelated PRs and passed on rerun:
- tests/uat/test_timeouts.py::test_cancellation_kills_trapping_child_and_grandchild (UAT process-state, medium-test shard 3): assertion 'zombie' == 'gone', on develop run 43254948280 after PR #4173 (2026-11-12).
- tests/unit/utils/test_heavy_vm.py::test_the_real_stop_process_is_group_killed_with_its_output_kept_and_no_leaked_worker, first CI run of PR #4189 (2026-11-12).
ci-spurious-failures-under-runner-congestion-20261115 covers a different watchdog test and the duration gate. The test already polls up to 5 s (_STATE_TIMEOUT_S) for 'gone', so the child stayed unreaped for 5 s; establish who should reap it and why it did not.

## Decision gate
For each test, find whether the flake is a test timing assumption (assert before reap) or a product defect (cancellation leaves an unreaped child in real use). A product defect gets fixed in the product; a test-only race gets a deterministic wait on the condition (reap or exit), never a sleep or a retry decorator.

## Guardrails
- No xfail, skip, rerun-on-failure marker or widened assertion that would also accept a real leak.
- Prove determinism with 200 sequential repetitions per test on an idle host through make heavy-run, plus a deterministic test that injects the identified timing. No deliberate CPU or memory load (load-based repetition caused the 2026-11-13 spin-loop leak; see ci-spurious-failures-under-runner-congestion-20261115).
